About accounting firms in London

London is home to 1430 accounting firms on the TaxReady directory with specialisms spanning Professional Services, Construction, and Real Estate. Across the city, firms hold an average Google rating of 4.7★ over 95,003 reviews — a genuine signal of local reputation rather than marketing spend.

The most-reviewed firms in London include Larkstoke Advisors, Taxfix UK (TaxScouts), and M.A.C.T Limited — all listed above with full profiles, specialisms, and direct enquiry.

How ranking works

Google reviews + profile strength.

Every firm gets a base score from their Google reviews (volume and rating combined, so small-sample 5-star firms don't leapfrog established ones). On top of that, we add a transparent profile-strength boost — capped at +30% — for firms actively keeping their TaxReady profile current.

Base scorelog(reviews) × rating
Claimed profile+15%
Specialisms listed+6%
Firm bio written+4%
Accreditations listed+3%
Fee range shown+2%
